source-integrity.provenance: SEC-filed Q2 FY2027 10-Q and 8-K exhibit anchor realized financials; issuer manufacturing/launch evidence is separated from FT and market-data origins.
source-integrity.freshness: financial evidence filed 2026-09-03; operating/capacity evidence current through 2026-09-22 and Scout acquisition 2026-09-23.
source-integrity.duplicateOriginCollapse: issuer syndication and mirrors are collapsed and are not counted as independent corroboration.
source-integrity.sourceIndependence: SEC/issuer, FT and market-data origins remain distinct.
source-integrity.rawDerivedConsistency: Filed revenue, cash flow, capex and ATM issuance constrain derived growth/liquidity claims; planned capacity is not treated as realized economics.

company-underwriting.financialOperatingTrajectory: Filed Q2 FY2027 revenue was $116.052M versus $73.386M a year earlier; YTD operating cash flow was $68.4M and free cash flow $21.3M, while capex remained material and management expects fleet investment to increase.
company-underwriting.balanceSheet: Cash, equivalents and short-term investments were about $865.4M, but roughly $120M of ATM equity issuance contributed to liquidity and creates dilution risk.
company-underwriting.customersContracts: Cumulative packet evidence supports backlog/RPO visibility and sovereign/defense demand; conversion remains distinct from recognized revenue.
company-underwriting.governanceCapitalAllocation: Manufacturing/fleet investment supports growth but GAAP losses, ATM issuance and capital intensity keep stewardship evidence mixed.
company-underwriting.pricingPowerConcentration: Recurring geospatial demand supports moderate value capture; defense concentration, hardware mix and substitutes constrain stronger pricing-power evidence.
company-underwriting.catalysts: Backlog conversion, Berlin manufacturing, Isar deployment and next-quarter execution.

thesisQuality.basis: Filed 58% YoY Q2 revenue growth plus cumulative backlog/recurring-demand evidence demonstrate adoption, offset by GAAP losses and hardware mix.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Filed revenue growth, positive YTD operating/free cash flow and substantial liquidity are strong, but capex intensity and dilution constrain the band.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Market valuation remains demanding relative to trailing revenue despite growth.

catalystScore.basis: Berlin manufacturing, Isar deployment and backlog conversion are identifiable catalysts with execution timing risk.

governancePower.basis: Growth/capacity execution is credible but ATM issuance, losses and capital intensity keep stewardship evidence mixed.

alignment2036.basis: Persistent Earth observation and sovereign geospatial intelligence serve durable infrastructure/security needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Satellite/data capability spans government, defense and commercial uses across shared infrastructure.

bottleneckControl.basis: Owned constellation and added manufacturing capacity create meaningful capability control, though substitutes exist.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Commercial and sovereign paths diversify demand, but capital intensity and defense concentration constrain robustness.

substitutionResilience.basis: Owned high-cadence imagery infrastructure creates moderate barriers, while commercial and government alternatives remain credible.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Berlin adds geographic manufacturing capacity and Isar is a named European launch partner, but realized redundancy and launch reliability remain unproven.

pricingPower.basis: Recurring demand supports moderate value capture; concentration, hardware mix and substitutes limit demonstrated scarcity rent.

riskEvidence.basis: Capital intensity, ATM dilution, concentration, substitution, valuation and launch/manufacturing execution risks are partly offset by liquidity and demand visibility.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current SEC-filed financials plus issuer capacity/launch evidence, independent reporting and market data support scoring; long-run unit economics remain undisclosed.

scoreRecord.thesis: Scaled Earth-observation infrastructure plus sovereign demand and added manufacturing/deployment capacity support durable relevance, while valuation, capital intensity and concentration constrain asymmetry.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Backlog and capacity must convert into durable GAAP economics without excessive dilution.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Next-quarter execution, Berlin-built Pelican production and Isar launch execution.

unknowns.item: Berlin realized utilization/unit economics and Isar mission economics are undisclosed.
Long-run customer concentration/renewal economics remain uncertain.
